code:
This project replaced an aging, single-point-of-
failure on-prem database with a secured, geo-
replicated, tested, and monitored Azure SQL
Database -- and found and fixed a real failover
gap along the way.

It did not automate the drill schedule, decommission
the old server, or build a re-baselining process --
named gaps for a future phase, not oversights we're
pretending don't exist.
caption: Not every problem solved -- every remaining one named, owned, and handed off.
